Maximum amount of agents an AI faction army will contain when limited by [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]].\\n\\n[[col:white]]2[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of artillery units an AI faction army will contain when limited by [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]].\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]20[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of cavalry and monster units an AI faction army will contain when limited by [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]].\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Number of units an AI faction can disband to allow the recruitment of a new unit that would make the army's total [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army Supplies[[/col]] cost exceed the limit.\\n\\n[[col:white]]2[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of melee infantry units an AI faction army will contain when limited by [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]].\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]60[[/col]] by default.

Maximum percentage of ranged infantry units an AI faction army will contain when limited by [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]].\\nThe percentage does not take the general and agents into consideration.\\n\\n[[col:white]]50[[/col]] by default.

Amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in AI faction armies.\\n\\nA unit's army supplies cost is the same as its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Enables army supplies restrictions for AI faction armies.\\n\\nWhen an AI faction recruits a new unit, if the combined supply cost of the army's units exceeds the limit, the AI automatically disbands some of its cheapest units to stay within the cap.\\nThe AI faction is then reimbursed for the cost of the disbanded units.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Enables logs for the code that applies restrictions to the AI.\\n\\nLogs are stored in the [[col:white]]totowar_logs.txt[[/col]] file in your game folder.\\nUseful when you need to report a bug in order to be able to figure out what is happening.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Amount of [[col:white]][[img:icon_merc]][[/img]]Army supplies[[/col]] available for recruiting units in a player's armies.\\n\\nA unit's army supplies cost is identical to its cost in a skirmish battle.\\n\\n[[col:white]]12400[[/col]] by default.

Enables army supplies restrictions for player armies.\\n\\nIf the combined army supplies cost of an army's units exceeds the limit, the army becomes immobilized until units are either disbanded or transferred to another army.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Enables logs for the code that applies restrictions to the player.\\n\\nLogs are stored in the [[col:white]]totowar_logs.txt[[/col]] file in your game folder.\\nUseful when you need to report a bug in order to be able to figure out what is happening.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.

Enables logs for code that updates the UI to display army supplies.\\n\\nLogs are stored in the [[col:white]]totowar_logs.txt[[/col]] file in your game folder.\\nUseful when you need to report a bug in order to be able to figure out what is happening.\\n\\n[[col:white]]Checked[[/col]] by default.
